name: Ba Be lake villages and Hua Ma cave
region: Ba Be National Park, Bac Kan
why: Through Tay stilt-house villages and rice fields beside Vietnam's largest natural lake, to a huge cave of stalactites in the forest.
book: Ba Be National Park ticket. Homestays in Pac Ngoi; boats on the lake.

points.name: Pac Ngoi
points.note: A Tay village of stilt houses on the lake shore.

points.name: Hua Ma Cave
points.note: A large cave of stalactites up a forest stair.
